## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The CLI should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can exclude files through the environment as required by the project’s flag policy.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters archive entries by filename and logs skipped files in verbose mode. It also documents the flag and adds parser, collection, and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` set and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns `[]`. The flag policy says each new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`). — CI archives can include files that the job configured the tool to skip.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test a literal exclusion against a nested filename — The tests leave `--exclude skip.log` against `sub/skip.log` unverified. The filtering tests use `*.log` and `*.tmp`, which match both basenames and full paths. — A regression to full-path matching would pass the suite while including nested files that users exclude by exact name.
